generations.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a production transparent pixel-art game sprite sheet, exactly 4 columns by 5 rows, all cells equal and isolated, NO text, NO labels, NO grid. Reference image is a character contact sheet: use its five character rows as exact identity, outfit, colors, outline and pixel grain references. Row order: Aria blonde elf green cloak flower; Leon brown spiky hair red cape armor; Mira lavender hair white-gold healer; Finn brown hair rogue tan coat; Lico reddish hair green botanist dress. Each row has FOUR poses facing slightly RIGHT: (1) sitting low on the ground or low stool, calm neutral face, EMPTY hands on knees; (2) same seated body, tired thoughtful worried expression; (3) same seated body, cheerful smile speaking with one empty hand; (4) crouching to examine something at ground level, one EMPTY hand extended downward, NO sack or object. Preserve walking reference HEAD SIZE, don't inflate seated heads. Seated/crouch bodies only 65-75% standing height; heads same physical size as walking. No cups, bags, food, furniture, backgrounds or shadows. Character proportions 2.5-3 heads, crisp detailed original JRPG sprites. Whole body fully visible, wide clear transparent gutters. Actual transparent alpha.

Use case: illustration-story. Transparent pixel-art game sprite sheet exactly 3 columns by 5 equal rows. Each row three poses: column1 neutral focused carrying; column2 concerned thoughtful carrying; column3 smiling talking carrying. Feet firmly at same baseline, head same size and center each column. No giant heads. Match walking reference stature. NO text labels grid props shadows background; transparent alpha.

Row2: ARIA standing facing right with ONE hand holding a long shoulder-bag strap that runs diagonally across her chest toward her far hip; two frames small weight shift. Do NOT draw a bag: it will be a separate prop aligned at her hip. Row3: MERRILL walking right while both gauntleted hands carry an INVISIBLE large cooking pot at waist height. Two alternating leg strides (left then right); face cheerful mischievous, mouth closed; both gauntlets present. Do not draw pot. Full bodies, same scale each row's pair, crisp pixel art with dark outlines. No labels text grid background shadows; real transparent alpha.

Edit this exact sprite sheet. Keep the 2-column 3-row layout and all character designs. REMOVE ALL background including the colored glows and dark field so every non-character pixel has fully transparent alpha. Edit this exact sprite sheet only by removing the little yellow/orange marks beside the faces in the RIGHTMOST COLUMN. Preserve every character's design, pose, size, outfit and the exact 3-column by 5-row grid. Keep actual transparent background; no text no symbols no effects.

Produce a NEW clean sprite sheet, not a reproduction of the background. Image 1 supplies the character designs only. Exactly two columns, three equal rows. Actual transparent empty space, alpha zero outside the solid character silhouettes; NO lighting, NO glow, NO haze, NO shadows, NO background color anywhere. Sharp small sprite game pixel art. No labels. Reference character silhouettes only; do not preserve any surrounding color cloud.

Create a FOUR-FRAME WALK CYCLE sprite sheet of Merrill, character reference image supplied. Exactly 4 equal cells horizontally in one row, no other rows. Facing RIGHT in profile/three-quarter.
